pages.heading: Mimic Octopus
pages.body: Warm oceans. Tame with Lobster Tails while it is not camouflaged. Slimeballs prevent drying for a time on land. Ink Sacs toggle random disguises;

pages.heading: Mimic Octopus (cont.)
pages.body: relevant mob drops select remembered forms. Mimicream unlocks combat abilities in those forms. Bucket tame specimens and breed with tropical fish. Keep away from sharks and Mantis Shrimp.
